ostheer.title: Ostheer standard 1v1 opener

steps.note: Build HQ extras only as needed. Scout toward nearest fuel.
Body for VPs and early MG cover.
Anchor a VP or cutoff. Avoid open field walks.
Mortar softens weapon teams; keep Pioneers repairing.
Read the map: Pak for armor pressure, flame/251 for bunkering infantry.
Do not over-tech if you are down a fuel. Trade up with vision.
Spend munitions on upgrades you will use this minute, not the next ten.

ostheer.adapt: If early light vehicles dominate the lane, prioritize Pak and mines over a second support weapon. On dense green maps, lean MG + grenades before a pure armor spike.

soviet.title: Soviet standard 1v1 opener

steps.note: Flood early VPs. Merge later; do not hoard.
Mines on fuel approaches, wire if a choke is obvious.
Penals for buildings/green; Maxim to freeze a push.

steps.item: Tier 2 / AT Rifle or ZiS path
steps.note: Respect enemy light armor timing.
T-70 for map move and soft targets; T-34 when fuel allows.
Guards hold mid fights; Su-85 if heavy armor appears.
Keep Conscripts upgraded; replacements are cheaper than hero units.

soviet.adapt: If the map is very open, skip a third early Conscript blob and reach T-70 sooner. In heavy cover, Penals and flamer engineers earn more than rushing mediums.

okw.title: OKW standard 1v1 opener

steps.note: Aggressive early. Place Mechanized HQ toward contested fuel when safe.
Vision and retreat path matter more than a greedy third building.
Mechanized for fuel maps; Infantry HQ when you need bodies and MG.
Do not let enemy lights free-rotate your HQs.

steps.item: Medium pressure (Luchs/250 path into Panzer IV/Panther)
steps.note: OKW spikes hard if both fuels are healthy.
Reset HQs if surrounded; a dead HQ is a lost tech tree.

okw.adapt: On cutoff-heavy maps, seed HQs deeper and play for one secure fuel rather than two greedy ones.

usf.title: USF standard 1v1 opener

steps.note: Core of the faction. Keep them alive for mid upgrades.
Pick the leadership that matches whether you want early weapons or armor unlocks.
One support weapon is enough early; do not stall tech.
Scout car or WC51 for map move; watch Pak/AT guns.
Only after fuel income is real. Support with rifle AT grenades/bazookas.
Airborne flanks or armor company spikes depending on commander.

usf.adapt: If the map denies safe vehicle paths, stay infantry-heavy longer and use captains/lieutenants aura fights around VPs.

ukf.title: UKF standard 1v1 opener

steps.note: Early presence. Sapper follows for wire/mines/emplacements.
Anchor a VP. UKF wins many games by not giving free rotates.
AT gun for vehicle maps; mortar for weapon-team maps.
Keep emplacements relevant; do not abandon the gun line.
Churchill for breakthrough/hold; Comet for mobile late.
Spend munitions on the section upgrades you fight with.

ukf.adapt: Woodland flank maps reward Commando doctrine sooner. Open fuel maps reward earlier AT guns and carrier play.
